text:
Anu: seeing other orgs' metrics in a customer's insights widget after fast org-switch.
Diego: repro steps?
Anu: 1) sign in as cust-a
2) open /console/insights?widget=errors
3) while the chart loads, switch to cust-b
4) reload -> chart shows cust-b traces in cust-a's view

Anu: quick curl I ran:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -H \"X-Org-Id: cust-a\" https://staging.console/insights/widget/errors
# then repeat with X-Org-Id: cust-b while session id stays same
```

Linh: logs:
```
info affinity=SESSION:sess42 tenant=cust-a cache_hit=true
info affinity=SESSION:sess42 tenant=cust-b cache_hit=true
```

Soren: probably the new prefetch/affinity change — we compute affinity before attaching tenant to ctx. same session id hits cached payloads across tenants.

Diego: action: patch affinity key to include tenant id; add integration test for rapid org-switch; emit telemetry metric cross_tenant_cache_hit.

Anu: file ENG-1092 for follow-up, owner Soren, priority P0.

deploy-bot: deploy started: console-proxy v1.12.0 -> v1.12.1 (patch) env=staging host=proxy-3

Soren: will watch telemetry and rollback if collisions >0. disabling canary if needed.

deploy-bot: canary passed; cross_tenant_cache_hit=0 in last 5m.

Anu: thanks team. follow-up: add org-switch smoke test to rollout checklist and a lint rule to require tenant reference in cache keys.
